module_summary: Edge propagator transmitter: a set/clear request register holds valid_o high from a valid_i pulse until a two-flop synchronized ack_i clears it.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input pulse that sets the held request register

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Held request level sent across domain, copy of r_input_reg

anchors.name: ack_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous acknowledge from receiver, synchronized to clear request

anchors.name: sync_a
anchors.why: Two-flop synchronizer shift register for ack_i; bit0 clears request

anchors.name: s_input_reg_next
anchors.why: Set/hold-until-ack next value of request register

groups.name: request_hold
groups.description: Request register set by valid_i, held until synchronized ack, drives valid_o

groups.name: ack_synchronizer
groups.description: Two-stage synchronizer bringing ack_i into this clock domain
